styles.name: Mist & prints
styles.summary: A low-contrast twilight dark that warms to a peach glow at the top; calm capitals, hairline rules, flyers framed like prints.

styles.name: Dusk editorial
styles.summary: Warm brown-charcoal with amber, square corners, serif headings and italic labels; a quiet, magazine-like dark.

styles.name: Forest notes
styles.summary: Deep green-grey with sand and sage, dashed notebook rules and lower-case labels; outdoorsy and calm.

styles.name: Paper cards
styles.summary: Cream paper with a muted rust accent, serif type, floating light cards and a pill-shaped header.

styles.name: Mist float
styles.summary: The dawn-mist dark with big rounded floating cards, friendly sentence-case type and a pill header.

styles.name: Sage soft
styles.summary: Pale sage with a faint paper grain, serif headings, dashed rules and matted flyers; a light, earthy look.
